tasks.label: Run tests with concise JSON summary
args:
const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const r=spawnSync('npm',['test','--','--format','json'],{shell:true,encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:30*1024*1024}); const o=r.stdout||''; const i=o.indexOf('['); if(i<0){console.log('npm test produced no JSON. exit='+r.status+'
'+o+'
'+(r.stderr||'')); process.exit(r.status||1)} let fs; try{fs=JSON.parse(o.slice(i))}catch(e){console.log('Could not parse Cucumber JSON: '+e.message+'
'+o.slice(-2000));process.exit(1)} const ss=fs.flatMap(f=>(f.elements||[]).filter(x=>x.type==='scenario'||x.keyword==='Scenario'||x.keyword==='Scenario Outline')); const fails=ss.flatMap(s=>s.steps.filter(x=>x.result&&x.result.status==='failed').map(x=>({s:s.name,step:x.name,error:x.result.error_message||''}))); console.log('Scenarios: '+ss.length+'; passed: '+(ss.length-fails.length)+'; failed: '+fails.length+'; features: '+fs.length); for(const f of fails){console.log('FAIL '+f.s+' / '+f.step+': '+f.error.split('
').slice(0,3).join(' ').slice(0,550))} if(r.stderr) console.log('npm stderr: '+r.stderr.slice(0,1000)); process.exit(fails.length||r.status||0)
